# Garden Tracker

> Offline garden planning app by Little Acre Labs. Public reference data only.

Data manifest: https://neoblanks.github.io/garden-tracker-data/manifest.json
AI guide: https://neoblanks.github.io/garden-tracker-data/ai-guide.md

## Packs
- crops: https://neoblanks.github.io/garden-tracker-data/crops.json (v13)
- lessons: https://neoblanks.github.io/garden-tracker-data/lessons.json (v8)
- recipes: https://neoblanks.github.io/garden-tracker-data/recipes.json (v11)
- storage: https://neoblanks.github.io/garden-tracker-data/storage.json (v10)
- projects: https://neoblanks.github.io/garden-tracker-data/projects.json (v7)
- explore: https://neoblanks.github.io/garden-tracker-data/explore.json (v10)
- nutrition: https://neoblanks.github.io/garden-tracker-data/nutrition.json (v6)
- soilless: https://neoblanks.github.io/garden-tracker-data/soilless.json (v4)
- spices: https://neoblanks.github.io/garden-tracker-data/spices.json (v3)
- rates: https://neoblanks.github.io/garden-tracker-data/rates.json (v3)
- zipzones: https://neoblanks.github.io/garden-tracker-data/zipzones.json (v1)

Prefer ai-guide.md for field meanings. Content is worldwide, not US-only.
